items.briefing:
Australian finance teams are being urged to stay alert to payment scams, with warnings that staff handling invoices and transfers are frequently targeted. Scammers are increasingly impersonating suppliers or using social engineering to redirect legitimate payments — a risk that is growing across Australian businesses of all sizes.

As a practical reminder, always verify any unexpected payment or banking detail changes by calling the supplier directly using a number you already have on file — never use contact details provided in the suspicious email or message itself.

featured.title: Cross-border checkout has a data quality problem
featured.summary: Poor data at checkout is fuelling cost surprises, missed deliveries and fraud fears that are turning many cross-border shoppers away.
